recommendation: Keep the source fix and let the normal FHIR build regenerate derived Schematron and StructureDefinition outputs; no further core source changes are indicated for this issue.
issue_request: FHIR-26565 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core Parameters after the generated Schematron global-1 rule applied to every FHIR XML element and rejected empty Parameters resources; the resolution was a technical correction recorded for R4/R4B and applied for R5.
initial_application: The issue was implemented on the R4B line by commit 3d8b755ddc, which added an empty Parameters exception to the ele-1 human text, FHIRPath expression, and generated-Schematron XPath source. That commit was not on the current branch, where source/datatypes/element.xml still lacked the exception.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes and the originating Zulip thread both confirm that empty Parameters resources can be valid and that the global Schematron was wrong. FHIR-31733 later documented the same R4B exception and said to ensure it was reflected in R5. FHIR-43103 later clarified the human text to say "or both", so the reconciliation preserved that wording while restoring the exception.
reconciliation: Changed source/datatypes/element.xml so ele-1 says empty Parameters resources are exempt, the FHIRPath expression allows `$this is Parameters`, and the XPath used for generated Schematron allows `self::f:Parameters`.
source_changes: source/datatypes/element.xml: updated ele-1 human text, FHIRPath, and XPath to exempt empty Parameters resources while preserving the later "or both" clarification.
